_README: Hand-curated overrides for build-exercise-art.mjs. Keys are exercise names EXACTLY as they appear in assets/catalog/catalog.json (.exercises[].name). Values are either a workout-guide slug (string) to force that illustration, or null to force-exclude an exercise the matcher would otherwise accept. Overrides always win over the automatic matcher. Slugs must exist upstream (packages/workout-guide/assets/<slug>/frame-1..3.svg) or the build fails loudly. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Example: { "Barbell Squat": "squat", "Smith Machine Squat": null }
_1_EQUIPMENT: The matcher now refuses art whose equipment contradicts ours (see equipmentCompatible). These entries are the exceptions it cannot reason about: where the right illustration exists under a different name, and where a different implement still draws the same picture.
_2_REMAPPED: Wrong implement in the art, but upstream has one with the right implement.
_3_KEPT: Equipment differs on paper but not in the drawing: bands added to a barbell lift, a goblet squat held with a kettlebell instead of a dumbbell, a weight added to a bodyweight movement.
_4_DROPPED: No upstream art draws these with the right implement. The initials monogram is the correct answer — a barbell press on a cable press is worse than no picture. Listed explicitly so the decision is visible and a future upstream addition is easy to spot.
